issues.display_title: Issue #2612: Integrate Comments with Comments API
issues.main_description_html:
Type

Integration

Overview

Fetch the comments list for the active post and wire the compose bar to the create-comment API. Implement optimistic comment insertion (add the new comment to the list immediately before API confirms). Handle comment pagination if the post has many comments.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Comments load on mount with the first page of results
  • Submitting a comment inserts it optimistically at the top/bottom of the list
  • If the comment API fails, the optimistic comment is removed and an error is shown
  • Pagination loads additional comments on scroll
  • Comment like/unlike fires the API with optimistic count update

https://www.figma.com/design/RSNRjxqnnr1O24SjpeoPI3/New-PANORRA-360?node-id=357-27367

Dependencies

  • #2591 (Zustand Store Architecture)
  • #2592 (API Service Layer)
  • #2610 (Comments Section)

issues.display_title: Issue #2607: Integrate Bookmark Tab with Bookmarks API
issues.main_description_html:
Type

Integration

Overview

Fetch the user's bookmarked posts for this place and populate the Bookmark tab. Wire the place-level bookmark toggle to the bookmarks API (save/unsave place). Sync bookmark state across the Posts tab cards so a bookmarked post shows its filled bookmark icon consistently.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Bookmarked posts for this place are fetched on tab activation
  • Place-level bookmark toggle calls the correct API (save/unsave)
  • Optimistic update occurs immediately; reverts on API failure
  • Bookmark icon state is consistent between the Bookmark tab and Posts tab cards
  • Bookmarks are reflected in placeStore so other screens can read current state

issues.display_title: Issue #2606: Integrate Contributors Tab with Contributors API
issues.main_description_html:
Type

Integration

Overview

Fetch the ranked contributors list for the current place from the API and populate the Contributors tab. Implement the follow/unfollow action with optimistic UI update and server-side confirmation.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Contributors list loads when the Contributors tab is first activated
  • Follow/unfollow API is called on button tap; UI updates immediately (optimistic)
  • If the follow API fails, the button reverts to its previous state with an error toast
  • Contributors are sorted server-side by post count (descending)
  • Pagination is supported if the contributors list exceeds a threshold

Viewer mode + auth gating. See docs/brainstorm/04-juni-2026/brainstorming-sign-in-sign-up.md.

  • closing the auth modal (X) sets authStore.isViewer = true → browse the map anonymously
  • gated actions (like, post, bookmark, comment, follow) re-open the auth modal
  • after auth, resume the originally attempted action (where feasible)
  • preserve the 4 auth paths (email · Google · Apple · viewer)

Testing Scenario (for tester)

  1. Close the auth modal → map is browsable in anonymous viewer mode.
  2. Tap a gated action (e.g. like/bookmark) → auth modal re-opens.
  3. Complete auth → the gated action proceeds (or returns to where it was).
  4. Viewer state is consistent across app restart until the user signs in.

Type

Integration

Overview

Connect the panorama viewer component to the post's panorama image URL from the API. Handle loading states, gyroscope-based motion control, and touch-based pan/tilt interaction on both Android and iOS.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Panorama image URL from the post API is passed to the viewer and rendered correctly
  • Gyroscope motion control works on physical devices (with permission handling)
  • Touch-based pan and tilt works as a fallback when gyroscope is unavailable
  • A loading spinner is shown while the panorama image streams/loads
  • An error state (broken panorama icon) is shown if the image URL fails to load
